name: Free At Last
summary: Lakota Windsong is making her way back to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post. After refusing Arnak Grimtotem, she was taken to his stronghold above Thousand Needles and now needs protection on the journey home.

sections.title: A Brutal Abduction
sections.body: Arnak Grimtotem wanted Lakota Windsong for his bride. When she refused, he returned by night and attacked her home. Lakota's brother tried to defend her, but Arnak struck him down. Then he dragged Lakota to Darkcloud Pinnacle.

sections.title: Escape from Darkcloud Pinnacle
sections.body: Darkcloud Pinnacle rises above Thousand Needles, with high wooden bridges linking its spires. Grimtotem warriors guard the heights. As Lakota makes her way down, you fight off bandits who mean to seize her before she reaches the canyon floor.

sections.title: A Bitter Homecoming
sections.body: Lakota reaches the canyon floor and makes her way to safety at Freewind Post. There, Thalia Amberhide welcomes her with relief, though she grieves for Lakota's brother. Thalia gives his remaining belongings to those who brought Lakota home alive.

faq.answer: Arnak Grimtotem wanted Lakota Windsong for his bride. After she refused him, he attacked her home at night. He struck down her brother when he tried to defend her, then dragged Lakota to Darkcloud Pinnacle.

aliases: how to get to darkcloud pinnacle
faq.answer: Darkcloud Pinnacle is a cluster of towering rock spires linked by bridges in northern Thousand Needles. It lies just southeast of the Great Lift and south of Razorfen Downs.
Arnak Grimtotem is a ruthless member of the Grimtotem tribe stationed on Darkcloud Pinnacle. He kidnapped Lakota and killed her brother. Horde authorities at Freewind Post have marked him for death.

faq.q: Who should you speak to after the rescue?
aliases: where to turn in free at last
faq.answer: After Lakota reaches the canyon floor, return to Freewind Post atop the high bluffs and speak with Thalia Amberhide.

faq.q: Why do the Grimtotem attack during the escape?
faq.answer: Arnak's Grimtotem bandits patrol the heights of Darkcloud Pinnacle. They ambush anyone trying to help Lakota, his intended captive, reach freedom.
Lakota's brother was killed defending her from Arnak Grimtotem during the kidnapping. Thalia later gives his heirlooms to those who rescue Lakota.

angles.text: The Grimtotem clan shows its disregard for peace and unity among the tauren through kidnapping and murder, even under the gaze of Freewind Post.
The Horde holds Freewind Post as an essential fortress in southern Kalimdor. Grimtotem lawlessness and kidnappings at Darkcloud Pinnacle threaten the road.
